records.name: Franz Freistilamt
records.biography_en: He treats the shortest route as a competitive moral achievement. His building league files residents as ahead or in the way. The kickboard once helped him practise; now it helps him explain why everyone else needs practice. A dissonant card has made him offer it without a lecture. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der kürzeste Weg wurde genehmigt. Rücksicht ist darin noch nicht enthalten.

variant_notes.note_en: He treats the shortest route as a competitive moral achievement.

records.name: Bruno Brustton
records.biography_en: He insists that progress should be symmetrical even when the world is not. He demonstrates symmetrical progress to a corridor that never stays straight. His joined palms make every disagreement look like a technique problem. He is beginning to notice that two neighbours moving differently can still arrive together. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er bewegt sich ordnungsgemäß. Das Wasser wurde zur Anpassung aufgefordert.

variant_notes.note_en: He insists that progress should be symmetrical even when the world is not.

records.name: Rita Rückenruhe
records.biography_en: She trusts the direction of travel less than the ceiling. She remains upright because the residents' pool committee has enough opinions about posture already. Her goggles stay in her hand while she studies an uncertain ceiling. A card about trusting others has made her accept directions from a neighbour. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie schwimmt auf Sicht. Vorsorglich nach oben.

variant_notes.note_en: She trusts the direction of travel less than the ceiling.

records.name: Bodo Butterflug
records.biography_en: He performs effort so visibly that the pool feels obliged to applaud. He makes every communal task look magnificently strenuous and divides applause into deserved or not yet delivered. The raised arms leave plenty of space for smaller residents. He has begun noticing their efforts between his own demonstrations. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Aufwand ist sichtbar. Ein Ergebnis wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

variant_notes.note_en: He performs effort so visibly that the pool feels obliged to applaud.

records.name: Mira Mehrbahn
records.biography_en: She has swum enough laps to suspect the finish is being moved. Her tin cup and rolled towel are the entire welfare budget of the long-distance committee. HyperNorm calls rest either earned or suspicious. She now offers a warm drink before asking which category the resident belongs to. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Noch eine Bahn. Die letzte wurde wegen guter Leistung verlängert.

variant_notes.note_en: She has swum enough laps to suspect the finish is being moved.

records.name: Paul Pausenpfiff
records.biography_en: He prepares for the next relay leg by checking whether it is still his turn. He keeps the relay's time while trying to establish whether waiting is a job. The rolled towel resembles a baton, which makes responsibility dangerously easy to hand over. A dissonant card suggests he could ask someone to share it. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er ist als Nächster dran. Eine vorherige Person ließ sich nicht ermitteln.

variant_notes.note_en: He prepares for the next relay leg by checking whether it is still his turn.
